- **Beyond Packages: Governing the AI Toolchain with Posit Package
Posit Package Manager started as a way to govern R and Python packages
— mirroring, curating, and controlling what makes it into your
environments. That job hasn't gone away, but it's no longer the whole
As AI agents become part of everyday data science work, teams need the
same governance discipline applied to a new set of artifacts: VS Code
extensions, AI plugins, and the growing ecosystem of tools that agents
use to get work done. In this talk, we'll look at how Package Manager
is expanding to meet that need.\
We'll start with a practical overview of AI plugins — what they are,
what capabilities they expose, and why curating them matters as much
as curating packages. From there, we'll show how PPM acts as a private
marketplace for these plugins, and how Posit Assistant and other AI
agents can connect to that marketplace directly. Finally, we'll get
hands-on with PPM's MCP server, showing how it makes agent-to-PPM
integration straightforward, and how AI plugins themselves can define
MCP servers hosted on Posit Connect and elsewhere — turning your
governed package repository into a governed tool repository.\
You'll leave with a clear picture of where package management is
headed as AI agents join the data science workflow, and concrete ideas
for how to keep that expansion safe, curated, and useful.
